# AiOrch

> AiOrch is a self-hosted autonomous engineering pipeline for coordinating coding agents, reviewing their changes and optionally delivering a GitHub pull request for human review.

Orchestration and session state run on customer infrastructure. Configured inference providers receive task context; GitHub and license validation are separate connections. Audit, test configuration, model routing and PR delivery depend on session settings.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](https://aiorch.ai/docs/): Overview and navigation.
- [Installation](https://aiorch.ai/docs/getting-started/): Set up the Docker distribution, connect a provider, scope a project and review your first agent plan.
- [Providers](https://aiorch.ai/docs/providers/): Choose CLI or API providers, test connections and assign models to planning, implementation and review.
- [Architecture](https://aiorch.ai/docs/architecture/): Understand what stays on your infrastructure, which endpoints receive traffic and where agent permissions matter.
- [Review & validation](https://aiorch.ai/docs/review-and-validation/): Configure revision rounds, independent audit and repository checks; understand verified and unverified outcomes.
- [Engineering guide](https://aiorch.ai/guides/parallel-coding-agents/): Scope tasks, order dependencies and review the integrated result when multiple coding agents work on one repository.
